_comment: Copy these into the Studio 'Run & Debug' method form after deploying the
policy contract. A published policy can never be edited, so read the values
before sending: a grant funded against this id is judged by exactly these

standard-v1.label: Standard milestone review
_reads_as: A jury less than 70% sure returns NEEDS_CLARIFICATION and releases nothing.
An appeal costs 10% of the milestone, with a floor of 0.001 GEN.
At most four review attempts per milestone.

strict-v1.label: Strict review for high-value milestones
_reads_as: Demands 90% of requirements for a substantial payout and an 85% confident jury.
The appeal bond is deliberately cheaper than standard-v1: a stricter jury
should be easier, not harder, to question.
